meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, FLUX, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 AI 模型生成或编辑各类图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成或修改视觉素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate or edit images with AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create or edit visual assets

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成或编辑图像（照片、插画、艺术作品等），支持基于参考图片修改。
howto.when: 当你要求生成或编辑图像，且内容不是流程图、电路图等技术图表时触发。

say.text: 生成一张日落山景照片。
say.note: 使用默认模型生成新图像

say.text: 把这张照片的天空改成紫色。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can generate or edit images (photos, illustrations, artwork, etc.) based on your description or modify existing images from reference pictures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate or edit an image, and the content is not a technical diagram like flowchart or circuit diagram.

say_en.note: Creates a new image using default model

say_en.text: Change the sky in this photo to purple.
